24: A thousand years ago, the Order of Chronos guarded the Heart of Time: the clock that holds all worlds together.
25: Kael was its youngest apprentice. Lyra, his older sister, was the brightest guardian the Order had ever known.

27: No! I can still make it… I just need one more second!
28: Kael used the Order's forbidden power: the SHIFT. He tried to turn back time to save her.
29: But time refuses to be rewritten. The Heart shattered into fourteen fragments that fell into fourteen different worlds.
30: Each fragment corrupted the creature that found it. And from the rift, a shadow was born with Kael's face.
